title: Terms of Payment Arrangements — Consumer Authorization and the Authorization Window
content:
A plan under Payment Arrangements starts only on the consumer's own authorization of the schedule and the payment method; Ridgeline never debits on terms the consumer has not authorized.

## Terms

1. A plan is authorized only when the handling date is no later than the last day of the authorization window counted from the plan's creation date.
2. The authorization window is the type's authorization window figure in calendar days, the day after the creation date being day one and the last day included.
3. A recorded telephone authorization suffices only where the type accepts a recorded telephone authorization; elsewhere the consumer signs electronically.
4. A plan still pending authorization after the window is cancelled with the close reason "authorization lapsed", and a consumer who declines the terms has the plan cancelled with the close reason "consumer cancelled".
5. A plan is authorized only while its status is pending authorization.

The creation date is read from the plan record; it is the record, not the consumer's recollection, that starts the window.

## Window boundary (hypothetical dates)

A plan is created on 5 June under a type whose window is 5 calendar days.

| Handling date | Day of the window | May the plan be authorized? |
|---|---|---|
| 6 June | Day 1 | Yes |
| 10 June | Day 5, the last day | Yes |
| 11 June | After the window | No; a plan still pending is cancelled as "authorization lapsed" |

## Points of judgement

- **Status.** A plan already active, suspended, broken, completed or cancelled is not authorized under this rule; only a plan pending authorization is.
- **Form of authorization.** On a type that does not accept a recorded telephone authorization, the authorization is an electronic signature.
- **Declined terms.** A consumer who declines the terms does not leave the plan pending; it is cancelled as "consumer cancelled".
